title: Mirror code extraction from demonstrations
hypothesis: A frozen demonstration encoder plus compact task code predicts the appropriate FV code while preserving heldout task utility and reducing deployed state/context cost vs direct ICL.
physical_object: frozen GPT-2 plus shared demonstration encoder and task FV decoder
mirror_coordinate: small predicted task code m from demonstration context
logical_multiplicity: 16 procedure x domain functions without replaying full demonstrations

task.type: synthetic deterministic procedure x domain prompts

development.allowed: train linear head/prototype on development-only task contexts; fixed code dim=4; no fresh-driven changes

storage.authority: actual serialized inference payload and remaining context bytes

success_gate: Direct ICL above chance and code-routed target accuracy within 5pp of direct ICL; at least 50% context-token reduction; total incremental payload lower than explicit FV+ID bank.
failure_gate: Valid direct ICL but extracted code fails target quality or storage/context gates.
not_established_gate: Direct ICL at/below chance; code prediction alone cannot establish useful functions.
boundaries: Synthetic GPT-2 prompt task only; not natural ICL compilation.
Count encoder/head, decoder and codes; no free pretrained state beyond pinned base model.
Prediction of task identity is not functional execution.
